title: Programming layer-by-layer liquid phase epitaxy in microfluidics for realizing two-dimensional metal–organic framework sensor arrays
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1849-1857
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00764F, Paper
Huijie Jiang, Bo Staeglich, Joachim Knoch, Sandeep Kumar, Neeraj Dilbaghi, Akash Deep, Sven Ingebrandt, Vivek Pachauri
A liquid-phase epitaxy approach is utilized for programmable growth of two-dimensional metal organic framework, Ni-BDC-NH2 and realization of sensor-arrays for the detection of diisobutyl phthalate in the concentration range from 1 to 20 μg mL−1.
